title: Grounded AI assistant
objective: Answer with relevant source records, safe limitations and official links; optional generation is explicitly configured.
guardrails: unsupported questions return NO_SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE. Optional OpenAI-compatible generation is off by default and output without source-record citations is rejected.
exitCriteria: Known query returns traceable source records. Unsupported query does not create facts. Network/model error cannot break discovery.
prototypeBoundary: This phase uses the Phase 09–17 prototype contracts. Database persistence and production auth are not claimed.
